page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 dedicated physical cores, providing 2 vCPUs, and 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 4.0 GB per core allocation. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate average single-core capabilities but lower multi-core and memory throughput. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance and single-threaded gzip compression fall into the average tier. However, multi-core CPU performance, Passmark CPU scores, and memory bandwidth are positioned in the lower percentiles. Database operations, Redis SET performance, and static web serving throughput also reflect these resource constraints, placing them in the lower performance brackets.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, the ecs.g7.large offers an entry-level general-purpose profile. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require dedicated CPU resources but do not demand high multi-threaded performance or massive memory bandwidth. This instance is suitable for lightweight web serving, basic single-threaded processing tasks, development environments, and low-traffic application hosting.
